description.fun: A Fossilized Bird joined to a Fossilized Dino, Arctozolt makes electricity by shivering its frozen upper half, and it has a hard time walking. It lived on prehistoric seashores, keeping its food fresh in the ice on its body, but it moved so slowly that it went extinct. Like the other Galar fossils, it may be inspired by the Crystal Palace Dinosaurs, a set of famously inaccurate dinosaur sculptures.
description.guide: An Electric and Ice-type Fossil Pokémon from Pokémon Sword and Shield, restored from the Fossilized Bird and the Fossilized Dino. It is one of four Galar fossils pieced together from mismatched halves.
description.tagline: A shivering fossil that sparks when it shakes
